title: Neon Apex
description: A high-energy dance pop ride with a square-wave lead cutting through a pulsing 909 groove. Two euphoric peaks bracket a stripped-back valley, building each time with richer harmony and brighter filter sweeps. By the final peak everything locks together in a rush of melody and momentum.
